title: Annotatio IV §.XXI: German liturgy before administration — Christ Himself true food and drink of eternal life
pass_a_gloss: Before the Administration and the prayers, when they confess: That Christ Himself (understand chiefly as to His crucified Flesh and poured-out Blood) has become to our hungry and thirsty souls the true Food and Drink of eternal Life — i.e. that Christ Himself (namely chiefly by His crucified body and poured-out blood) yields to our hungering and thirsting souls as true food and drink. In the prayers preceding administration, when they supplicate God: That their toilsome and crushed hearts may be fed and refreshed with Christ’s true Body and Blood — yes with Him, true GOD and Man, the true Bread of Heaven — through the power of the Holy Spirit — i.e. that their fatigued and torn souls may feed and be refreshed with Christ’s true body and blood, nay with Him whole, true GOD and man, that eternal heavenly bread.
pass_b_english: Before administration they confess: Christ Himself — chiefly as crucified flesh and poured blood — has become true food and drink of eternal life to hungry, thirsty souls.
In the preceding prayers they ask that crushed hearts be fed and refreshed with Christ’s true Body and Blood — yes with Him, true God and Man, heaven’s bread — by the Holy Spirit’s power.
source_text: Ante Administrationem quidem precesque, quando confitentur: Das Christus selbst (verstehe vornehmlich seinem gecreuzigtem Fleisch und vergossenem Blut nach) unseren hungerigen und durstigen Seelen / zur wahren Speiß und Tranck des ewigen Lebens worden sey. i. e. Christum ipsum (puta corpore præcipuè suô crucifixô & sanguine effusô) animabus nostris esurientibus ac sitientibus, in verum cibum potumque cedere. In precibus, administrationi præmissis, quando Deo supplicant: Daß ihre mühselige und zerschlagene Herzen / mit Christi wahrem Leib und Blut / ja mit ihm / wahren GOTT und Menschen / dem wahren Himmel Brodt / durch die Krafft des Heil. Geistes / gespeiset und erquicket werden. i. e. quò animæ suæ fatigatæ ac dilaceratæ, verô Christi corpore & sanguine, quin ipso totô, DEO verô homineque, æterno illo pane cœlesti vescantur ac refocillentur.

lemmas.gloss: with Christ’s true body and blood

notes: Before: Christ true food/drink; Spirit feeds.
